name: Pixelation — effect fixture
description: Proving fixture for the pixelation Effect. Samples one exact source texel at the center of each stable 48×48 native-pixel cell, then holds that unchanged premultiplied color across the cell. The photographic gradients and high-contrast type make the square grid unmistakable while proving that the Effect adds no dither, posterization, palette remapping, blur, or background fill. Fixture — exercises the Pipeline, not held to the deliverable floors.

content.title: One sample. One square. Every color stays untouched.
content.author: PIXELATION — 48 × 48 NATIVE PIXELS
